actions.script: const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.InboxServices.get#InboxData').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {accountList: out.accountList, internalEmailAccountId: out.internalEmailAccountId, mailboxList: out.mailboxList, searchList: out.searchList, totals: out.totals, me: out.me, prefs: out.prefs, failedParts: out.failedParts, outOfOfficeList: out.outOfOfficeList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.InboxServices.find#InboxRows').parameters({view: view || null, emailAccountId: account || null, emailFolderId: folder || null, emailLabelId: label || null, contactListId: mailbox || null, searchText: q || null, unreadOnly: String(unreadOnly) === 'true', cursor: cursor || null, pageSize: pageSize ? Number(pageSize) : 50}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {threadList: out.threadList, hasMore: out.hasMore, nextCursor: out.nextCursor, storeList: out.storeList, failedStores: out.failedStores, termList: out.termList, conversationView: out.conversationView})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.InboxServices.get#ThreadView').parameters({store: store || '', threadId: threadId || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {thread: out.thread})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.InboxServices.search#LinkRecords').parameter('term', term || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : (out.optionList || []))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.shared.ChatterServices.search#Users').parameters({term: term || '', limit: 12}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? [] : Array.from(out.userList || []).map((user) => ({value: user.partyId, label: user.label})))

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.InboxServices.get#MailboxHeader').parameter('contactListId', contactListId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {mailbox: out.mailbox})

const list = (text) => text ? String(text).split(',').map((id) => id.trim()).filter((id) => id) : [] const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.InboxServices.set#ThreadState').parameters({targetsJson: targetsJson || '[]', action: action || '', snoozedThruDate: snoozedThruDate ? new Date(Number(snoozedThruDate)) : null, emailFolderId: emailFolderId || null, addLabelIdList: list(addLabelIds), removeLabelIdList: list(removeLabelIds)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {updatedCount: out.updatedCount, failedList: out.failedList, doneKeys: out.doneKeys})

const list = (text) => text ? String(text).split(',').map((id) => id.trim()).filter((id) => id) : [] const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.InboxServices.apply#ViewAction').parameters({view: view || null, emailAccountId: account || null, emailFolderId: folder || null, emailLabelId: label || null, contactListId: mailbox || null, searchText: q || null, unreadOnly: String(unreadOnly) === 'true', action: action || '', snoozedThruDate: snoozedThruDate ? new Date(Number(snoozedThruDate)) : null, targetEmailFolderId: emailFolderId || null, addLabelIdList: list(addLabelIds), removeLabelIdList: list(removeLabelIds)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {updatedCount: out.updatedCount, failedList: out.failedList, threadCount: out.threadCount})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.InboxServices.link#ThreadRecord').parameters({emailMessageId: emailMessageId || null, communicationEventId: communicationEventId || null, recordEntityName: recordEntityName || '', recordId: recordId || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {communicationEventId: out.communicationEventId, created: out.created, link: out.link, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize('Linked') + (out.link ? ': ' + out.link.title : ''), link: out.link?.url || null, linkText: ec.l10n.localize('Open')}]})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.comms.MailSettingsServices.sync#UserAccounts').parameter('emailAccountId', emailAccountId || null).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {startedList: out.startedList, failedList: out.failedList})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.comms.InboxServices.respond#Invitation').parameters({emailMessageId: emailMessageId || '', response: response || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {workEffortId: out.workEffortId, statusId: out.statusId, replySent: out.replySent, messageInfos: [{type: 'success', message: ec.l10n.localize({accept: 'Accepted', tentative: 'Tentative', decline: 'Declined'}[response] || 'Answered'), link: out.workEffortId ? '/qapps/Commons/Calendar/EventDetail?workEffortId=' + encodeURIComponent(out.workEffortId) : null, linkText: ec.l10n.localize('Open event')}]})
ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.impl.EmailClientServices.delete#EmailSearch').parameter('emailSearchId', emailSearchId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.marketing.ContactListServices.leave#ContactList').parameter('contactListId', contactListId || '').call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {left: out.left})
ec.service.sync().name('mantle.marketing.ContactListServices.remove#ContactListParty').parameters({contactListId: contactListId || '', partyId: partyId || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})
ec.service.sync().name('mantle.marketing.ContactListServices.decline#ContactListParty').parameters({contactListId: contactListId || '', partyId: partyId || ''}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})

const members = memberPartyIds ? String(memberPartyIds).split(',').map((id) => id.trim()).filter((id) => id) : [] const out = ec.service.sync().name('mantle.marketing.ContactListServices.create#ContactList').parameters({contactListTypeEnumId: 'MAILBOX', contactListName: contactListName || '', description: description || null, isPublic: isPublic === 'Y' ? 'Y' : 'N', postingEnumId: postingEnumId || null, defaultDeliveryEnumId: defaultDeliveryEnumId || null, memberPartyIdList: members}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse(ec.message.hasError() ? {} : {contactListId: out.contactListId})

ec.service.sync().name('mantle.marketing.ContactListServices.update#ContactList').parameters({contactListId: contactListId || '', contactListName: contactListName || null, description: description ?? null, isPublic: isPublic === 'Y' || isPublic === 'N' ? isPublic : null, postingEnumId: postingEnumId || null, defaultDeliveryEnumId: defaultDeliveryEnumId || null, archived: archived === 'true' ? true : (archived === 'false' ? false : null)}).call() ec.web.sendJsonResponse({})
